descripcion: GFX Tool: AI Lag Fix 120FPS is an Android game optimizer built with Java, Android SDK, Java NIO, DocumentFile, DocumentsContract, and Shizuku API. It uses AI-assisted settings selection, device-specific optimization, and OpenGL/Vulkan extensions to customize graphics, enable supported 120 FPS, and improve gaming smoothness across Android 6–16.
